description: A science store makes two boxes, a cheap and expensive box. The cheap box contains 3 units of metal and 5 units of acid which can be mixed to create 8 units of foam. The expensive box contains 5 units of metal and 8 units of acid which can be mixed to create 10 units of foam. The cheap box however gives off 2 units of heat while the expensive box gives off 3 units of heat. The science store has available 200 units of metal and 300 units of acid. If at most 50 units of heat can be given off, how many of each box should the store make to maximize the amount of foam produced?

MaxHeat.definition: Maximum units of heat that can be given off

MetalPerBoxType.definition: Units of metal required per box type

AcidPerBoxType.definition: Units of acid required per box type

FoamPerBoxType.definition: Units of foam produced per box type

HeatPerBoxType.definition: Units of heat given off per box type

objective.description: "Maximize the total amount of foam produced from the cheap and expensive boxes"

constraints.description: The total metal used by all boxes produced should not exceed the total available metal
The total acid used by all boxes produced should not exceed the total available acid
The total heat generated by all boxes produced should not exceed the maximum allowable heat
The number of boxes produced for each box type should be non-negative

NumBoxes.definition: Number of boxes produced for each box type
